audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-6].side (full layer) reads Pyke, Pyke, Pyke, Pyke, Skill, Skill, Skill while content win[0-6] reads Lux, Lux, Lux, Lux, Pyke, Pyke, Lux — the two layers disagree on every single row.
audit.why: The content layer's whys[] already explain a grounded story that matches the kit: Lux outranges Pyke's short Q pre-6, Pyke's R execute (100/85/70s) flips control at 6 and through the first back, and Lux's late Final Spark range wins it back. The full layer's side/why fields never got updated to match.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 phases[].side to match win[N], and rewrote each phases[].why to state the same reason as the paired content whys[N], grounded in real cooldowns (Bone Skewer channel, R execute timer).

audit.why: Power spikes (Lvl 2 outrange, Lvl 6 execute threat, 1st item burst window, late Final Spark range) are already stated with real numbers in content.spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two matchup-defining interactions from missingInteractions were absent: Bone Skewer (Q) is an interruptible channel Lux's Q cancels outright, and Pyke's passive bypasses stacked resistances so raw armour/MR is the wrong itemization answer.
audit.why: These directly change how to play the pull window and how to itemize, and were missing in favor of templated cooldowns text with no digits.
audit.corrected: Added the Q-cancels-channel fact to dosFull[1] and breakdown.cooldowns, and the resistance-bypass fact to dontsFull[2]. Left the stealth-reveal interaction as notes since dosFull/dontsFull slots were already used by higher-priority fixes.
